source_refs.note: Diode as a Rectifier: a main subheading of 17.14 Rectification, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 106-106.

blocks.text: Forward bias mein diode bara current guzarne deta hai, lekin reverse bias mein current taqreeban zero hota hai. Diode ki isi khaas property (khoobi) ki wajah se ise rectification ke liye istemal karte hain, yani AC ko unidirectional (ek hi taraf behne wala) current, yani DC, mein badalna.

blocks.title: Brain teaser
blocks.text:
Mobile phone AC jama karta hai ya DC?
Phone ki battery DC jama karti hai, kyunke DC ko jama karna AC se aasan hai, aur DC zyada safe (mehfooz) bhi hai. Bijli ka grid sirf AC deta hai, is liye phone, laptop ya torch charge karne se pehle rectifier AC ko DC mein badalta hai.
